briefdescription.para: REST controller for appointment records of the appointment-providing entities.

detaileddescription.para: This file defines the Appointments controller, which exposes create, read, update, delete and search endpoints for appointments. A {entityType} part of the URL (clinics, pharmacies, laboratories or radiologycenters) selects one concrete AppointmentController from a registry held in a std::variant. Each handler either awaits an async controller coroutine or calls executeControllerMethod for blocking database work, depending on the configuration. Every handler first builds a callback that converts the controller's numeric status into a standard JSON HTTP response and builds a Requester from the identity attributes set by Auth.

WHY THIS FILE MATTERS IN THE SERVER: This controller is the HTTP front door for all appointment management. Drogon routes the /api/v2 appointment URLs here; the handlers then call the shared dispatcher in basic/common.hpp, which calls the appointment controllers and entities and ultimately the database. It depends on the Auth filter for identity and on the service locator for the executor and controllers. Without it there would be no way for clients to book, view, change or cancel appointments through the API.

CONCEPTS TO LEARN (for beginners):
REST create/read/update/delete (CRUD) routes: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Methods
std::variant (a type-safe union): https://en.cppreference.com/w/cpp/utility/variant
HTTP filters/middleware: https://drogon.docsforge.com/master/filter/
C++ coroutines (co_await): https://en.cppreference.com/w/cpp/language/coroutines
